name: Floating Image
author: WeDevlops.com

sections.description:
Floating Image adds custom image using URL links allows you to add a floating image.

Functionality:

Dynamic Visual Element: This plugin allows you to add a floating image to your WordPress site, which can attract the attention of visitors due to its movement and placement.

Engaging Design: The floating image is designed to stand out, making it an effective tool for highlighting important information or calls to action.

Customizable Image: No need to upload any image and simply use the URL image to avoid space on your hosting, giving you full control over the visual content.

Responsive and Mobile-Friendly: The floating image works seamlessly across all devices, ensuring a consistent and smooth experience on desktops, tablets, and smartphones.

Easy Integration: Simple to install and configure, allowing you to quickly add the floating image URL with minimal effort.

Use Cases: Ideal for promotions, announcements, sign-ups, or directing traffic to specific pages.

This plugin enhances your WordPress site by adding a floating image with a custom image URL. It’s a versatile tool for capturing attention and guiding users to important parts of your website, thereby increasing engagement and conversions.
